# Jane Ann & Skinner

- [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) — Relative of — [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) — cousin · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and is met by Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who gives her a ride to her boarding house, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) garrulously shares stories about her courtship with her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), her decision to marry for love over money, and her cousin [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ann's unhappy marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance
